fields.name: redir-policy
fields.description: Redirection to GERAN security policy (redir-policy): 0 = Unsecured redirection to GERAN allowed, 1 = Unsecured redirection to GERAN not allowed. Bits 2 to 4 are spare and shall be set to 0

notes: Network policy value: Redirection to GERAN security policy (redir-policy) (octet 1, bit 1)
1: Unsecured redirection to GERAN not allowed
Bits 2 to 4 are spare and shall be set to 0
